description: TomperWear — toko + admin CMS + API dalam satu deploy (single Vercel project)
name: tomperwear

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:admin
scripts.build:admin: cd admin && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && REACT_APP_BACKEND_HOST= CI=false npm run build && mkdir -p ../public/admin && cp -r build/. ../public/admin/ && cd ..
scripts.build:web: cd web && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && REACT_APP_BACKEND_HOST= CI=false npm run build && rm -rf ../public && mkdir -p ../public && cp -r build/. ../public/ && cd ..
